sayLines.text: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced; the food-thesis deeds. The climb is not over.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Strike is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

grants.why: The feast is warm and good — but your reactor hums its steady note underneath, and the fire never catches. 1.25x, always, is all there is. (Feast buff refused:
